710000.full: παρα-βιάζομαι [in LXX: Gen.19:9, 4Ki.2:17 (פָּצַר), Deu.1:43 (זוּד hi.), 1Ki.28:23 (פָּרַץ) see1. 4 * ;] __1. prop., to force against nature or law. __2. to compel by force (Polyb.). __3. to constrain by entreaty (Ge, 1Sam, ll. with): Luk.24:29, Act.16:15.† (AS)

710002.full: 1. to look aside, take a side look , (Aristophanes Comicus); π. θατέρῳ (i.e. ὀφθαλμῷ); to look suspiciously with one eye, (Aristophanes Comicus) 2. to see wrong , (Lucian) (ML)

710003.lxx: in LXX (cf. McNeile, Mt., 185): Num.23:7, Deu.28:37, Psa.44:14, Pro.1:6, Eze.12:22, al. (מָשַׁל), Sir.47:17 (חִידָה), al. mutt. in Sir, Wis.5:3
710003.full: παραβολή, -ῆς, ἡ (παραβάλλω), [in LXX (cf. McNeile, Mt., 185): Num.23:7, Deu.28:37, Psa.44:14, Pro.1:6, Eze.12:22, al. (מָשַׁל), Sir.47:17 (חִידָה), al. mutt. in Sir, Wis.5:3 ;] __1. a placing beside, juxtaposition (Polyb., al.). __2. a comparing, comparison (Plat., Arist., al.). __3. a comparison, illustration, analogy, figure (Arist., al.) : Mat.24:32, Mrk.3:23, Heb.9:9 11:19; specif. of the pictures and narratives drawn from nature and human life which are characteristic of the synoptic teaching of our Lord, a parable: Mat.13:3, 10 Mrk.4:2, 10, Luk.8:4, 9-11, al.; with genitive ref., Mat.13:18, 36 __4 4 Like Heb. מָשַׁל (1Ki.10:12, Pro.1:6, Sir.3:29, al.), = παροιμία, a proverb or gnomic saying: Luk.4:23 5:36 6:39 SYN.: παροιμία (see Abbott, Essays, 82 ff.) (AS)

710004.lxx: in LXX for שָׁמַע pi., hi., etc.
710004.full: παρ-αγγέλλω (παρά, ἀγγὲλλω), [in LXX for שָׁמַע pi., hi., etc. ;] __1. to transmit a message (Æsch., Eur.). __2. to order, command (Hdt., Xen., al.) : with inf., Act.15:5; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.11:17, 2Th.3:4, 1Ti.4:11 5:7; before ἵνα (M, Pr., 207; Bl., § 69, 4), Mrk.6:8, 2Th.3:12; with dative of person(s), Act.17:30 R, txt., 1Th.4:11; before λέγων, Mat.10:5; with inf. aor., Mat.15:35, Mrk.8:6, Luk.8:29, Act.10:42 16:18 (aoristic pres.; see M, Pr., 119); id. with neg., μή, Luk.5:14 8:56, Act.23:22, 1Co.7:10; with inf. pres., Act.16:23, 2Th.3:6; id. with neg., ιή, Luk.9:21, Act.1:4 4:18 5:28, 40, 1Ti.1:3 6:17; with accusative, τοῦτο, before ὅτι (E1., § 70, 3), 2Th.3:10; with accusative and inf., Act.23:30, 2Th.3:6, 1Ti.6:13 (Bl., § 72, 5).† SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)

710005.full: 1. a message transmitted by beacons, (Aeschulus Tragicus) 2. an order, command , ἀπὸ παραγγέλματος by word of command , (Thucydides) 3. an instruction, precept , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

710006.full: παρα-γίνομαι (Ion. and late for -γίγν-), [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] __1. to be beside or at hand (Hom., Hdt., al.), hence, to stand by, sup­port (Æsch., Thuc., al.) : with dative of person(s), 2Ti.4:16. __2. to come, come up, arrive (Hdt., Xen., al., and frequently in later writers; see MM, xviii; Thackeray, Gr., 267.2): absol., Luk.14:21 19:16, Jhn.3:23, Act.5:21-22, 25 9:39 10:32-33 11:23 14:27 17:10 18:27 21:18 23:16, 35 24:17, 24 25:7 28:21, 1Co.16:3; before εἰς, Jhn.8:2, Act.9:26 15:4; ἐπί, with accusative, Luk.22:52; πρός, with accusative, Luk.7:4, 20 8:19, Act.20:18; id. before ἐκ, Luk.11:6; παρά, with genitive, Mrk.14:43; ἀπὸ . . . εἰς, Mat.2:1, Act.13:14; ἀπὸ . . . ἐπὶ . . . πρός, Mat.3:13; of a teacher coming forward in public: Mat.3:1, Luk.12:51, Heb.9:11.† (AS)

710007.full: παρ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;] __1. trans., to lead by, lead aside, lead into, lead forward, etc. __2. Intrans., __(a) to pass by: Mat.9:9, 27 20:30, Mrk.2:14 15:21, Jhn.8:59 R, txt., Jhn.9:1; before παρό, with accusative, Mrk.1:16; __(b) to go away, depart; metaphorically, to pass away: 1Co.7:31; mid., 1Jn.2:8 Jn 2:17.† (AS)

710008.full: 1. a pattern or model of the thing to be executed, Lat. exemplar, an architect's plan , (Herdotus Historicus); a sculptor's or painter's model , (Plato Philosophus) 2. a precedent, example , (Thucydides); ἐπὶ παραδείγματος by way of example , (Aeschines Orator) 3. an example , i. e. a lesson or warning , π. ἔχειν τινός to take a lesson from another, (Thucydides); τὸ σὸν π. ἔχων (Sophocles Tragicus); ζῶντά τινα τοῖς λοιποῖς π. ποιεῖν (Demosthenes Orator) 4. an argument, proof from example , (Thucydides) 5. the model or copy of an existing thing, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

s: to set forth as an example; in bad sense, to put to open shame
710009.lxx: in LXX: Num.25:4 (יָקַע hi.), Jer.13:22 (חָמַס ni.), Eze.28:17 (רַאֲוָה), Est.4:17, Dan LXX 2:5 *
710009.full: παρα-δειγματίζω (δείκνυμι), [in LXX: Num.25:4 (יָקַע hi.), Jer.13:22 (חָמַס ni.), Eze.28:17 (רַאֲוָה), Est.4:17, Dan LXX 2:5 * ;] to set forth as an example; in bad sense, to put to open shame: Heb.6:6 (Polyb., Plut., al.).† (AS)

s: Paradise, the abode of the blessed dead
710012.lxx: in LXX chiefly for גַּן, Gen.1:8 ff.,  al.; also for עֵדֶן, Isa.51:3; פַּרְדֵּס, Neh.2:8, Ecc.2:5
710012.full: παράδεισος, -ου, ὁ (an Oriental word, first used by Xen. of the parks of Persian kings and nobles) [in LXX chiefly for גַּן, Gen.1:8 ff., al.; also for עֵדֶן, Isa.51:3; פַּרְדֵּס, Neh.2:8, Ecc.2:5 ;] __1. a park, pleasure-ground, garden (LXX), an orchard (in π., see MM, ii, xviii; Deiss., BS, 148). __2. Paradise, the abode of the blessed dead: Luk.23:43, 2Co.12:4, Rev.2:7.† (AS)

710013.full: παρα-δέχομαι [in LXX: Exo.23:1 (נָשָׂא), Pro.3:12 (רָצָה), 2Ma.4:22 R, 3Ma.7:12 * ;] to receive, admit; __(a) of things: Mrk.4:20, Act.15:4 16:21 22:18, 1Ti.5:19; __(b) of persons: Heb.12:6 (LXX).† (AS)

710014.full: παρα-δίδωμι, [in LXX chiefly for נתן ;] correl. to παρδέχομαι, __1. to give or hand over to another: with accusative and dative, Mat.11:27 25:14, Luk.4:6, al.; of being delivered up to a course of teaching, pass. before εἰς, Rom.6:17. __2. to commit, commend: Act.14:26 15:40, 1Pe.2:23. __3. to give or deliver up to prison or judgment: with accusative of person(s), Mat.4:12, Mrk.1:14, Rom.4:25, 2Pe.2:4; id. before ὑπέρ, Rom.8:32; with dative, Mat.5:25, Mrk.15:1, Luk.12:58, Jhn.19:11, al.; id. before ἵνα, Jhn.19:16; with inf., Act.12:4; before εἰς, Mat.10:17 17:22 24:9, Luk.21:12, Act.8:3, 2Co.4:11, al.; τ. Σατανᾷ, 1Ti.1:20; id. before εἰς, 1Co.5:5; with the collat. idea of treachery (= προδίδωμι), with accusative of person(s), Mat.26:25, Mrk.14:11, Jhn.6:64, al.; id. with dative, Mat.26:15, al.; present ptcp., ὁ παραδιδοὺς, Mat.26:25, Mrk.14:42, Jhn.13:11. __4. to hand down, hand on or deliver verbally (traditions, commands, etc.): Mrk.7:13, Luk.1:2, Act.6:14, 1Co.11:2 15:2; pass., 2Pe.2:21, Ju 3. __5. to permit (for exx. in cl., see LS, see word): Mrk.4:29. (AS)

710015.full: to do an incredible thing; render notorious

s: contrary to received opinion, incredible, marvellous
710016.full: παράδοξος, -ον (παρά, δόξα), [in LXX: Jdth.13:13, Wis.5:2 16:17 19:5, Sir.43:25; 2-4 Mac 3 * ;] contrary to received opinion, incredible, marvellous: pl., Luk.5:26.† SYN.: see: δύναμις (AS)

710018.lxx: in LXX: Est.7:26 (אֵסוּר), Jer.32:4 (נָתַן ni.), Jer.34:2 *
710018.full: παρά-δοσις, -εως, ἡ (παραδίδωμι), [in LXX: Est.7:26 (אֵסוּר), Jer.32:4 (נָתַן ni.), Jer.34:2 * ;] __1. a handing down or over, transfer, transmission (Arist., Polyb., al., LXX). __2. tradition of doctrine (Plat., Epict., al.); by meton., of the doctrine itself : Mat.15:2-3, 6, Mrk.7:3, 1Co.11:2, Gal.1:14, Col.2:8, 2Th.2:15 3:9.† (AS)

710019.full: a running beside or over, traversing , (Plutarch); ἐν παραδρομῇ cursorily , (Aristotle Philosopher) (ML)

710021.full: παρα-ζηλόω, -ῶ [in LXX: Deu.32:21, 3Ki.14:22, Psa.78:58 (קָנָא pi., hi.), Psa.37:1, 7-8 (חָרָה hith.), Sir.30:3 * ;] to provoke to jealousy: Rom.10:19 (LXX) Rom.11:11, 14, 1Co.10:22.† (AS)

710023.full: παρα-θαλάσσιος, -α, -ον (παρά, θάλασσα) [in LXX: Jer.47:7 (יָם חוֹף), etc. ;] by the sea: Mat.4:13.† (AS)

710026.full: to heat to excess :—;Pass., aor1 participle παραθερμανθείς, of a man become quarrelsome in his cups, (Aeschines Orator) (ML)

710027.full: juxta-position, neighbourhood , (Polybius Historicus); ἐκ παραθέσεως on comparison , (Polybius Historicus) (ML)

710028.full: παρα-θήκη, -ης, ἡ (παρατίθημι), [in LXX: Lev.6:2, 4 (Lev 5:21, 23) (פִּקָּדוֹן), and in Tob 10:13, 2Ma.3:10 2Mac 3:15, seel. for παρακαταθήκη (which see) * ;] a deposit or trust: 1Ti.6:20, 2Ti.1:12 1:14 (for exx. of this form, see MM, Exp., iii, xviii).† (AS)

710032.full: 1. to take away from beside, withdraw, remove , (Euripides):—; with genitive partitive to take away part of a thing, (Euripides):—;Pass., παρῃρημένοι τὰ ὅπλα having their arms taken from them, (Thucydides) 2. π. ἀρὰν εἰς παῖδα to draw aside the curse on thy son's head, (Euripides) 3. Mid. to draw over to one's own side, seduce, detach , (Xenophon Historicus) 4. to take away , (Xenophon Historicus): Mid., παραιρεῖσθαι τὴν θρασύτητα to lessen, damp it, (Demosthenes Orator) 5. generally, to take away from, steal away from , τί τινος (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

s: to beg of or from another
710033.lxx: in LXX for בָּקַשׁ pi., etc.
710033.full: παρ-αιτέομαι, -οῦμαι [in LXX for בָּקַשׁ pi., etc. ;] __1. to beg of or from another: Mrk.15:6 (Rec. ὅνπερ ᾐτοῦντο, see Field, Notes, 43). __2. to deprecate; __(a) prop., with neg., to entreat that not (Thuc., al.): Heb.12:19; __(b) to refuse, decline, avoid: o. accusative, 1Ti.4:7 5:11, 2Ti.2:23, Tit.3:10, Heb.12:25 (EV; but see Field, Notes, 234). __3. to beg off, ask to be excused, excuse (Polyb., al.) : Luk.14:18-19 (Heb.12:25, Field, l.with).† (AS)

710036.full: Dep. to be seated beside or near another, with dative, (Aristophanes Comicus), etc. (ML)

710037.full: παρα-καθίζω [in LXX: Job.2:13 (יָשַׁב)* ;] to set beside; act. for mid., to sit down beside: Luk.10:39, Rec. (for -έζομαι, which see).† (AS)

s: to invoke, call on, beseech, entreat
710039.lxx: in LXX chiefly for נחם ni., pi.
710039.full: παρακαλέω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for נחם ni., pi. ;] __1. to call to one, call for, summon: Act.28:20 (R, mg.; R, txt., entreat); hence (of the gods: Dem., Xen., al.), to invoke, call on, beseech, entreat: τ. πατέρα μου, Mat.26:53; τ. κύριον, 2Co.12:8; in late writers (Polyb., Diod., al.; rarely in LXX; in π., see Deiss., LAE, 176.14), also of men: absol., Phm 9; with accusative, Mat.8:5, Mrk.1:40, Act.16:9, al.; with inf., Mrk.5:17, Luk.8:41, Act.8:31, al.; before ἵνα (see M, Pr., 205, 208), Mt 14"36, Mrk.5:18, Luk.8:31, al. __2. to admonish, exhort: absol., Luk.3:18, Rom.12:8, 2Ti.4:2, al.; with accusative, Act.15:32, 1Th.2:11, Heb.3:13, al.; id. before inf., Act.11:23, Rom.12:1, Php.4:2, 1Th.4:10, al.; before ἵνα (see M, Pr., l.with), 1Co.1:10, 2Co.8:6, 1Th.4:1, al. __3. to cheer, encourage, comfort (Plut., LXX: Jb 43, Isa.35:3, Sir.43:24, al.): with accusative, 2Co.1:6, Eph.6:22, Col.2:2, al.; id. before ἐν, 1Th.4:18; διά, 2Co.1:4; pass., Mat.5:4, Luk.16:25, Act.20:12. SYN.: παραμυθέω (cf. M, Th., 25). (AS)

710040.full: anything hung up beside or before, a covering, curtain , (Plutarch):—;metaphorically an excuse , τινος for a thing, (Plutarch) from παρακᾶλύπτω (ML)

710041.full: παρα-καλύπτω [in LXX: Isa.44:8 (פָּחַד), Eze.22:26 (עָלַם hi.)* ;] to cover by hanging something beside, to hide: metaphorically (as Plat., al.), Luk.9:45.† (AS)

710042.full: παρα-κατα-θήκη, -ης, ἡ (παρακατατίθημι) [in LXX: Exo.22:8, 11 (מְלָאכָה), and elsewhere as seel. for παραθήκη, which see ;] more usual than its variant in Gk. writers for a trust or deposit: 1Ti.6:20, 2Ti.1:14, Rec.† (AS)

710044.full: παρά-κειμαι [in LXX: Jdt.3.2-3, Sir.30:18 34:16, Dan LXX Bel 1:14, 2,3 Mac.5* ;] to lie beside, be near, be present: Rom.7:18, 21.† (AS)

710045.full: 1. Dep. 2. to order one to do a thing, advise, prescribe , τί τινι (Herdotus Historicus), etc.; π. ταῦτα to give this advice , (Plato Philosophus);—;also, π. τινι, with infinitive, (Plato Philosophus) 3. to exhort , τοιαῦτα παρακελευσάμενος having delivered this address , (Thucydides):—;absolute to encourage one another by shouting , (Herdotus Historicus) 4. παρακεκέλευστο in passive sense, orders had been given , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

710047.full: παρά-κλησις, -εως, ἡ (παρακαλέω), [in LXX : Job.21:2, Psa.94:19, Hos.13:14, Nam.3:7, Isa.57:18 66:11, Jer.16:7 (נָחַם, its parts and derivatives), Jer.38:9 (תַּחֲנוּן), Isa.28:29 30:7, 1Ma.10:24 1Mac 12:9, 2Ma.7:24 2Mac 15:11 * ;] __1. a calling to one's aid, summons (Thus.), hence, appeal, entreaty (Strab., Plut., al., 1Ma.10:24; of. Lft., Notes, 20) : 2Co.8:4. __2. exhortation, encouragement: Act.15:31, Rom.12:8, 1Co.14:3, 2Co.8:17, Php.2:1, 1Th.2:3, 1Ti.4:13, Heb.12:5; λόγος (τῆς) π., Act.13:15, Heb.13:22; υἱὸς π., Act.4:36. __3. consolation, comfort (Phalar., LXX) : Luk.6:24, Act.9:31, 2Co.1:4-7 7:4 7:7 7:13, 2Th.2:16, Phm 7; τ. γραφῶν, Rom.15:4; θεὸς τῆς π., Rom.15:5, 2Co.1:3; π. τοῦ Ἰσραήλ (see Dalman, Words, 109 f.), Lk (AS)

710050.full: 1. to bend or turn aside , παρακλίνας κεφαλήν (Odyssey by Homer); π. τὴν θύραν, τὴν πύλην to set it ajar , (Herdotus Historicus) 2. metaphorically, ἄλλῃ παρκλίνουσι δίκας they turn justice from her path , (Hesiod) 3. to lay beside another:—;Pass. to lie down beside , at meals, Lat. accumbere, τινι (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) 4. intransitive to turn aside , (Iliad by Homer); παρακλίνασα having swerved from the course , (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

s: to follow as a standard of conduct
710053.full: παρ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 2Mac 9:27 R* ;] with dative, to follow closely, accompany. (For exx. from π., see MM, xviii.)† (AS)

710055.full: παρ-ακούω [in LXX: Est.3:3, 8 (עָבַר, עָשָׂה, with neg.) Later (as in LXX, Polyb., Plut.; also in π., see MM, xviii), to hear without heeding, take no heed: Mrk.5:36; with genitive, Mat.18:17.† (AS)

s: to pass by, go past, elude
to pass by one another, to overlap
710066.full: 1. to make things alternate, to transpose , (Plato Philosophus) 2. to change or alter a little , (Herdotus Historicus) 3. of Place, to pass by, go past, elude , (Xenophon Historicus):—; to get rid of , (Plutarch) 4. to go beyond, exceed in point of time, (Plutarch) 5. intransitive to pass by one another, to overlap , (Herdotus Historicus) 6. to differ, vary , (Herdotus Historicus):—;impersonal, οὐ σμικρὸν παραλλάττει it makes no small difference , (Plato Philosophus) 7. π. τοῦ σκοποῦ to go aside from the mark, (Plato Philosophus) 8. to deviate from the course, to be liable to deviation , (Plato Philosophus); λόγοι παραλλάσσοντες delirious , (Euripides) 9. to slip aside or away , (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

s: to reason falsely, hence, to mislead
710067.lxx: in LXX chiefly for רָמָה pi.
710067.full: παρα-λογίζομαι [in LXX chiefly for רָמָה pi. ;] __1. to miscalculate. __2. to reason falsely, hence, to mislead: Col.2:4, Jas.1:22.† (AS)

710069.full: a loosening by the side: paralysis, palsy , (Theophrastus Philosophus) (ML)

710070.lxx: in LXX: Jer.6:24, Jer 27:43, Eze.21:7 (רָפָה), etc.
710070.full: παρα-λύω [in LXX: Jer.6:24, Jer 27:43, Eze.21:7 (רָפָה), etc. ;] __1. to loose from the side, set free. __2. to weaken, enfeeble; pass., to be en­feebled, esp. by a paralytic stroke: Luk.5:18, 24, Act.8:7 9:33, Heb.12:12" (LXX) .† (AS)

710071.lxx: in LXX: Pro.12:7, Da TH Dan.11:17 (עָמַד), etc.
710071.full: παρα-μένω [in LXX: Pro.12:7, Da TH Dan.11:17 (עָמַד), etc. ;] to remain beside or near: Heb.7:23, Jas.1:25; of remaining alive, 1Co.16:6 (WH, κατα-), Php.1:25 (cf. συμ-παραμένω).† (AS)

710072.full: παρα-μυθέομαι, -οῦμαι [in LXX: 2Ma.15:9 (Sm. 8)* ;] __1. to en­courage, exhort. __2. to comfort, console: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.11:31, 1Th.2:11 5:14; id. before περί, Jhn.11:19.† SYN.: παρακαλέω (AS)

710073.full: παραμυθία, -ας, ἡ (παραμυθέομαι) [in LXX: Est.8:13, Wis.19:12 * ;] __1. encouragement, exhortation. __2. comfort, consolation: 1Co.14:3 .† SYN.: παράκλησις (AS)

710074.full: παραμύθιον, -ου, τό (παραμυθέομαι) [in LXX: Wis.3:18 * ;] __1. an exhortation, persuasion, encouragement: Php.2:1 (cf. Plat., Legg., vi, 773 E, al.; see Lft. and ICC, Phi., l.with). __2. assuagement, abatement, hence, consolation (Wis, l.with, and frequently in cl.).† (AS)

710077.full: to spend amiss, to waste, squander , (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass., of persons, to be sacrificed uselessly , 3rd plural aor1 παραναλώθησαν (Plutarch) (ML)

710078.lxx: in LXX for הָלַל, etc., chiefly in Pss and 2Mac
710078.full: παρα-νομέω, ῶ [in LXX for הָלַל, etc., chiefly in Pss and 2Mac ;] to be a παράνομος, to transgress the law: Act.23:3.† (AS)

710080.full: 1. acting contrary to law, lawless , (Euripides) 2. of things, contrary to law, unlawful , (Aristophanes Comicus), etc.:—;adverb, παρανόμως, illegally , (Thucydides) 3. in attic law, παράνομα γράφειν, εἰπεῖν to propose an illegal measure , (Demosthenes Orator); παρανόμων γράφεσθαί τινα to indict one for proposing such a measure , (Demosthenes Orator): the indictment itself was παρανόμων γραφή (Aeschines Orator):—;in superlative, παρανομώτατα γεγραφότα (Aeschines Orator) (ML)

710082.full: a knife worn beside the sword, a dirk , (Strabo Geographus) (ML)

710083.full: 1. altogether, absolutely , generally with Art., τὸ π. (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—;with a negative, τὸ π. οὐδέν not at all , (Herdotus Historicus); οὔκ εἰμι τὸ π. ἄθεος (Plato Philosophus) 2. in reckoning, ἐπὶ διηκόσια τὸ παράπαν up to two hundred altogether , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

710085.full: that which is spread before a thing, a hanging curtain , (Herdotus Historicus):—;metaphorically a screen, cover , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

710087.lxx: in LXX chiefly for מָרַד qal., hi., מְרִי, most frequently in Psa and Eze
710087.full: παρα-πικραίνω [in LXX chiefly for מָרַד qal., hi., מְרִי, most frequently in Psa and Eze ;] to embitter, provoke: absol. (yet sc. τ. θεόν, cf. Psa.106:7, Eze.2:5-8, al., and with τὸν θ. added, Psa.5:4, Eze.20:21, al.), Heb.3:16 (cf. παραπικρασμός).† (AS)

710088.lxx: in LXX: Psa.95:8 (מְרִיבָה elsewhere rendered Λοιδόρησις, Exo.17:7; ἀντιλογία, Deu.33:8, al.; λοιδορία, Num.20:24)*
710088.full: παρα-πικρασμός, -οῦ, ἁ (παραπικραίνω) [in LXX: Psa.95:8 (מְרִיבָה elsewhere rendered Λοιδόρησις, Exo.17:7; ἀντιλογία, Deu.33:8, al.; λοιδορία, Num.20:24)* ;] provocation: ἐν τῷ π. (Heb. at Meribah), Heb.3:8, 15" (LXX) .† (AS)

710089.full: παρα-πίπτω [in LXX: Eze.14:13 15:8 18:24 20:27 (מָעַל), Eze.22:4 (אָשַׁם), Est.6:10 (נָפַל hi.), Wis.6:9 12:2, 2Ma.10:4 A* ;] __1. most frequently (Hdt., Thuc., al.), to fall in one's way, befall. __2. to fall into or in (before εἰς, Polyb.; with dative, 2Mac, l.with). __3. to fall away (En, Wis, ll. with; in Polyb., with genitive) : absol., Heb.6:6. __4. to fail (λόγος, Es, l.with; cf. 1Ki.3:19).† (AS)

710094.full: παρα-πορεύομαι [in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;] __1. to go beside, accom­pany. __2. to go past, pass by: Mat.27:39, Mrk.11:20 15:29; before διά, with genitive, Mrk.2:23 9:30 (WH, mg.).† (AS)

710095.lxx: in LXX for מַעַל, פֶּשַׁע, etc.
710095.full: παρά-πτωρμα, -τος, τό (παραπίπτω), [in LXX for מַעַל, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;] __1. a false step, a blunder (Polyb.). __2. Ethically, a misdeed, trespass (LXX): Mat.6:14-15, Mrk.11:25-26, Rom.4:25 5:15 ff Rom.11:11-12, 2Co.5:19, Gal.6:1, Eph.1:7 2:1, 5, Col.2:13.† SYN.: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)

710096.full: a falling beside; κατὰ τὴν π. τινος in the course of an action, (Polybius Historicus) (ML)

s: to flow by, drift away, slip away
710098.full: παρα-ρρέω [in LXX: Isa.44:4 (יָבַל), Pro.3:21 * ;] to flow by, drift away, slip away: Heb.2:1.† (AS)

710099.full: to throw beside : metaphorically to run the risk of doing a thing, with participle, π. λαμβάνων (Sophocles Tragicus): to throw aside, reject , [variant datesAnthology Palantina (ML)
